D: An FBI agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfing bank robbers.
P: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny Utah orders two.
S: after a dawn surf with Bodhi
Crispy battered fish in small tortillas with slaw, lime and chipotle mayo. Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 180ml cold beer and fry at 180C until golden.
King prawns skewered with garlic, chilli and lime, grilled over coals 90 seconds a side.
M: Pork and beef meatballs simmered an hour in marinara, packed into long rolls with provolone, grilled until melted. Two each.
Flathead strips in a beer batter fried at 180C, in warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and chipotle crema (sour cream, chipotle, lime).
W: Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, strawberry sauce, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Mexican lager with a wedge of lime, ice cold from a cooler in the sand.

s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, the zest and juice of a lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill over hot coals for 90 seconds a side. Serve with lime wedges.

s.note: after a dawn surf with Bodhi
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in a batter of 120g flour and 180ml cold beer and fry at 180C until golden. Serve in 12 small tortillas with shredded cabbage, lime and 4 tbsp mayonnaise mixed with chipotle.

m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 400g pork mince with 1 egg, 50g breadcrumbs, 40g grated parmesan and salt, and roll into 24 meatballs. Brown, then simmer in 700ml passata with 2 garlic cloves for 1 hour. Pack into 8 long rolls, top with 8 slices provolone and grill until melted. Two each.

w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into four dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for fudge. Top with fudge, sliced strawberries, whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry.

d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of Mexican lager in a cooler full of ice for an hour. Push a wedge of lime into the neck of each bottle just before handing it over. Drink it by the fire.
